name: What types of cabinet damage can Frasheski Construction repair?

mainEntity.name: What types of cabinet damage can Frasheski Construction repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: Frasheski Construction can repair various types of cabinet damage, including loose hinges, damaged doors, drawers that don't slide properly, and minor structural issues. We address cosmetic damage like scratches, dents, and chipped finishes, aiming to restore both functionality and appearance. Understanding the extent and type of damage helps us determine the most effective repair approach and whether a repair or replacement is more suitable for your specific needs.
acceptedAnswer.description: We repair loose hinges, damaged doors, malfunctioning drawers, and cosmetic issues like scratches and chips to restore cabinet functionality and appearance.
